description: This donut chart, titled “Topics” and associated with the paper “M³EL: A Multi-task Multi-topic Dataset for Multi-modal Entity Linking,” visually represents the distribution of four distinct topic categories within the dataset. The chart is composed of four colored segments, each labeled with its corresponding percentage value and color-coded in a legend located in the center. The largest segment, colored light blue, accounts for 41.2% and corresponds to the “Common” topic. The second largest segment, in pink, represents “Person” at 30.5%. The third segment, light green, is labeled “Book” at 14.9%. The smallest segment, light yellow, represents “Sport” at 9.1%. The chart includes a legend that maps each color to its respective topic, and each segment is clearly labeled with its percentage value, allowing for direct comparison of the proportions. The chart is presented as a donut chart with a white center, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the top right.
